video.title: (ENG) 10 Tips & Tricks for Kha Zix that beginners might not know about
video.description:
Kha tips: 

1. Passive unssen threat reset when ever going into unwarded bush
2. You can Tiamat + Q mid air if E is evolved
3. Your Q gets 50+ bonus range when evolved 
4. Your Q is extended when mid air if E is evolved
5. Whenever kha is in ulti he is ignoring unit collision which means he can´t be minion blocked
6.  Kha Zix W evolved gives sight of enemies 
7.  Your passive also slows which means your combo will look like this: aa + passive with slow + Q 
8. Your ulti can cancel targeted abilities such as Darius ulti if timed correctly 
9. Flash will cancel your E jump so use Flash then E not the opposite way around 
10. Your Q is not an auto attack so you can still Q things such as Pantheon with passive block Jax with E counter strike active 

Bonus tip: 
Animation cancel on W after you have landed with e

video.title: WHAT CAN COMICS DO for League of Legends lore?
video.description:
MY OPINIONS IN SUMMARY:

- Comics are a fantastic way to do maintenance on overlooked and underexplored areas and characters in LoL without jeopardizing the canon or requiring massive resources to pull of successfully.

- Copy and exploit the advantages of models of publishing and franchise management used by Marvel, DC, Star Wars and other big media properties with huge numbers of characters.

- Outsource, bring in contractors, be ok with retconning and flexible canon, and most of all: INCREASE THE VOLUME OF OUTPUT

- Nothing is worse than silence. Lore needs to breathe to live, and not every breath needs to be a shout. Be OK with the low-impact, low-stakes story, be ok with treading water and letting the story simmer for a bit.
